D: A swinging sixties secret agent is thawed out in 1997 to stop his old enemy Dr. Evil.
P: Serve the snacks when Austin is unfrozen in the nineties.
S: Classic devilled eggs dusted with paprika, a sixties cocktail party must. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, halve and mash the yolks with 4 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tsp mustard.
Cheese and pineapple cubes on toothpicks stuck into half a rockmelon, very sixties. Cube 250g cheddar and half a pineapple and thread onto toothpicks.
M: Dr. Evil's one million dollar steak
Dr. Evil's one million dollar demand
Steak Diane with a creamy mushroom and brandy sauce, the sixties fancy dinner. Sear 4 thin sirloin steaks for 2 minutes a side and rest.
W: Layers of jam sponge, custard, red berries and cream, as British as Austin. Layer 1 sponge cake spread with jam, 500ml custard, 250g raspberries and blueberries and 300ml whipped cream in a glass bowl.
K: Gin stirred with dry vermouth and served up with an olive. Lemonade for the kids.

s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, halve and mash the yolks with 4 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tsp mustard. Pipe back in and dust with paprika.
Cube 250g cheddar and half a pineapple and thread onto toothpicks. Stick them into half a rockmelon for a hedgehog. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.n: Dr. Evil's one million dollar steak
m.note: Dr. Evil's one million dollar demand
m.how: Sear 4 thin sirloin steaks for 2 minutes a side and rest. Fry 200g mushrooms and a shallot, add 40ml brandy, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp Dijon and 150ml cream and reduce. Pour over the steaks with fries.

w.how: Layer 1 sponge cake spread with jam, 500ml custard, 250g raspberries and blueberries and 300ml whipped cream in a glass bowl. Chill 2 hours. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.how: Stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth with ice and strain into 4 chilled glasses with an olive each. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
